best_idea: A two-state subtile fog (a known ring around the walker, the stood-on subtile visited and never downgraded) with a corridor rule for directional fills, and encounter rolls gated by a cooldown and a per-axis move.
decision_why: Take the two-state fog, the never-downgrade rule and the corridor rule, written from scratch, with the fill_s edge defect and the stamp-before-gates quirk fixed; reject wall-clock cooldowns, which conflict with the server-tick ruling (count cooldowns in server ticks).
acceptance: A test player walking a zone reveals a 3x3 known ring (5x5 with a scout test perk), the stood-on subtile stays visited after the walker leaves, a fill_s corridor is visible to the grid edge after one step, and a server test shows no encounter roll inside a city area and at most one roll per cooldown in server ticks.
